effective.basis: TCG release of the Duelist League 15 participation cards (DL15-EN004), the first printing carrying the once-per-turn limit

transitions.historical_text: You can tribute up to 2 Pyro-Type monsters. If you do this, this card gains ATK equal to the number of Tributed monsters x 1000. During battle between this card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower than the ATK of this card, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent. Destroy this card at the end of this turn.
transitions.modern_text: Once per turn: You can Tribute up to 2 Pyro-Type monsters; this card gains 1000 ATK for each. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. During the End Phase: Destroy this card.
transitions.summary: Wording only, on period rulings (round 037, 2026-09-29). The record claimed: The modern card's Tribute-for-ATK effect is once per turn; the claim is that the era card's effect had no limit and could be used repeatedly in one turn, stacking 1000 ATK per Pyro monster Tributed. A period ruling in force says otherwise: Konami TCG Card FAQ default_fh page (Internet Archive capture served 2008-12-15): "You can only use the effect of "Gaia Soul the Combustible Collective" to Tribute Pyro-Type Monsters once per turn." No difference between the era card and the modern card is established.

review.notes:
NO HISTORICAL IMPLEMENTATION IS RECORDED DESPITE THE FUNCTIONAL VERDICT: upstream's official/c51355346.lua registers the ATK effect as EFFECT_TYPE_IGNITION with s.atkcost and NO SetCountLimit, so the shipped implementation still permits repeated use in one turn and already reproduces the era behaviour; the only SetCountLimit(1) in the file is on the End Phase self-destruction trigger. Flagged conflicting-evidence because upstream's script contradicts the card's own current printed text ('Once per turn:', DL15-EN004, 2012-12-15). If upstream adds the count limit, this card needs a historical implementation and a reserved passcode. Era text at the Edison snapshot is v1 (DR3-EN088, 2006-11-25); v0 (RDS-EN028, 2004-12-01) differs only in wording ('increase the ATK of this monster by ... points', 'Destroy this card during the End Phase'), so the chain starts at v1. This card has no upstream historical or unofficial variant of any kind.

Round 037 (2026-09-29). Checked against period rulings: the differences the functional transition claims were searched for in the Konami-hosted UDE card FAQ (2008-12), the 2005 UDE card rulings page, Konami's errata lists, rulebooks and per-set ruling documents, and the archived UDE judge-list threads Yugipedia points to (the transition's rulings_check; docs/research/text-only-errata-audit.md, Gaia Soul the Combustible Collective). A period ruling in force contradicts every difference the transition claimed: The modern card's Tribute-for-ATK effect is once per turn; the claim is that the era card's effect had no limit and could be used repeatedly in one turn, stacking 1000 ATK per Pyro monster Tributed. Contradicted by Konami TCG Card FAQ default_fh page (Internet Archive capture served 2008-12-15): "You can only use the effect of "Gaia Soul the Combustible Collective" to Tribute Pyro-Type Monsters once per turn." Upper Deck Entertainment official Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Rulings page (Internet Archive replay): "You can only use the effect of "Gaia Soul the Combustible Collective" to Tribute Pyro-Type Monsters once per turn." The transition is cosmetic: no difference between the era card and the modern card is established. Verdicts: [event] d1 contradicted at Edison, contradicted at Tengu. Variant-script points a ruling contradicts, listed for the owner (Ignis's script is not edited): Gaia Soul the Combustible Collective: Ignis's script (the modern implementation) has no once-per-turn limit on the Tribute effect; the FAQ says one. An implementation gap, not a history question. Superseded summary, kept verbatim: "'Once per turn:' was added to the Tribute-for-ATK effect. The era text - 'You can tribute up to 2 Pyro-Type monsters. If you do this, this card gains ATK equal to the number of Tributed monsters x 1000' - is an Ignition effect with no activation limit, so it could be used repeatedly in the same turn, stacking 1000 ATK per Pyro monster Tributed. The piercing clause ('During battle between this card and a Defense Position monster whose DEF is lower ...' to 'If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage') and the self-destruction ('at the end of this turn' to 'During the End Phase:') are reworded only." Superseded coverage, kept verbatim: kind: "none-needed".
